questions.question: When using EFI Fiery controllers with Ricoh PDF printers, what does the % Printed property actually indicate, and at what point does it show as complete?

questions.question: If I need to modify the definition of a custom property after it's already been set up and in use, what steps do I have to take, and is there any extra work after reactivating it?

hot folder input device with a pre-submitted PDF file
supplied history record notification and a workflow with StoreInRepository step

questions.question: When I install a new color conversion CMR using AFP Resource Installer, what does the software automatically do, and how does that help the printer?

questions.question: When building widgets in Predictive Insight using Job Step Progress data, why would summing Cumulative pages stacked across all steps give wrong totals, and how do you fix it?

Use a formula or filter to include values from only one row in the database table

questions.question: When I shut down a Passthrough printer in RICOH ProcessDirector while a job is actively printing, what status does that job end up in?
